facts.en: Completed a diploma in IT Support at Fictional Institute D058 in 2025.
facts.zh: 2025 年在虚构院校 D058 完成 IT 支持专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a supervised service-desk intern at Fictional Technical Centre D058 from 2025-09 to 2026-06.
facts.zh: 2025-09 至 2026-06 在虚构技术中心 D058 担任受监督的服务台实习生。

facts.en: Recorded user-reported symptoms, checked approved knowledge articles and escalated unresolved tickets.
facts.zh: 记录用户报告的症状，查阅获批知识文章，并上报未解决工单。

facts.en: Read application log excerpts supplied by a supervisor; did not access production hosts or change logging settings.
facts.zh: 阅读主管提供的应用日志摘录；未访问生产主机或更改日志设置。

facts.en: Observed a supervisor using a cloud console during 3 demonstrations; held no cloud account or administrator permissions.
facts.zh: 在 3 次演示中观察主管使用云控制台；未持有云账户或管理员权限。

facts.en: In a 2025-04 course lab, wrote SQLite SELECT and JOIN queries against a fictional 120-row equipment table.
facts.zh: 在 2025-04 课程实验中，针对虚构的 120 行设备表编写 SQLite SELECT 和 JOIN 查询。

facts.en: The SQL work was coursework only, not production database administration or operational query ownership.
facts.zh: SQL 工作仅为课程作业，并非生产数据库管理或运营查询负责经历。

facts.en: Built a local practice virtual machine in 2026-01 and documented restarting a toy service; it was not a cloud deployment.
facts.zh: 2026-01 建立本地练习虚拟机，并记录重启玩具服务的过程；这不是云部署。

facts.en: With another intern, reviewed 40 closed training tickets during 2026-03 and flagged 7 missing escalation reasons for the supervisor.
facts.zh: 在 2026-03 与另一名实习生复查 40 个已关闭培训工单，向主管标出 7 个缺失上报理由。

facts.en: The supervisor added clarification to 5 of those 7 records; 2 remained unresolved at the end of the review.
facts.zh: 主管为其中 7 条记录中的 5 条补充说明；复查结束时仍有 2 条未解决。

facts.en: Handled a peak of 12 supervised ticket intakes in a 2026-02 week; the usual weekly allocation was 6.
facts.zh: 在 2026-02 的一个高峰周处理 12 个受监督工单接收；通常每周分配 6 个。

facts.en: Drafted a password-reset knowledge article in 2026-05; it was not approved for users and no password resets were performed independently.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草密码重置知识文章；未获准向用户发布，也未独立执行密码重置。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Coding Circle V058 on weekends from 2025-10 to 2026-02 during the internship, arranging chairs and sharing beginner worksheets.
facts.zh: 实习期间的 2025-10 至 2026-02，周末在虚构编程社团 V058 志愿摆放座椅及分发入门练习单。

facts.en: Enjoys assembling mechanical puzzles; no professional hardware-repair experience is claimed.
facts.zh: 喜爱组装机械谜题；不声称具备专业硬件维修经验。

facts.en: Used clear handover notes to separate observed symptoms from suspected causes and untested fixes.
facts.zh: 使用清晰交接记录区分已观察症状、推测原因及未经测试的修复。

facts.en: A draft bio says cloud-certified, but the only attached evidence is a webinar attendance email with no certification exam record.
facts.zh: 一份简介草稿写为云认证，但唯一所附证据为网络讲座出席邮件，没有认证考试记录。

facts.en: A personal notebook labels a lab highly available, but the saved diagram shows one local virtual machine and no failover test.
facts.zh: 个人笔记将实验标为高可用，但保存的图示仅有一台本地虚拟机，没有故障转移测试。

facts.en: No production deployment, infrastructure-as-code authoring, independent incident command or cloud administration is evidenced.
facts.zh: 没有证据支持生产部署、基础设施即代码编写、独立事故指挥或云管理经历。
